annotations.annotation_text: Page 165 opens Book 1, Chapter 6 ("The Quiz Chapter") during the Age of Gods phase. This passage continues twelve questions and answers probing HCE's identity, the Mookse and the Gripes parable, Professor Jones, featuring Shem, Shaun, Professor Jones, the Mookse, the Gripes. annotations.annotation_text: Swiftian presence "swift" on page 165 ("The Quiz Chapter"): the Dean of St. Patrick's Cathedral haunts this passage within twelve questions and answers probing HCE's identity, the Mookse and the Gripes parable, Professor Jones.
